title: The Evolution of Dataset Distillation: Toward Scalable and Generalizable Solutions

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing methods like FairDD that align datasets with protected attribute groups through synchronized matching to mitigate majority group dominance and handle long-tailed distributions.
Reviewing mathematical frameworks and reweighting schemes (using supervised contrastive learning and kernel density estimation) that analyze and mitigate color or background amplification.
Reviewing model-agnostic solutions that leverage bias-free intermediate features or disentangle features into architecture-invariant meta features to combat architecture-specific inductive biases.
Reviewing data generation techniques that embed horizontal flipping into the distillation process to break bilateral equivalence (symmetric replication of discriminative parts).
Reviewing dataset distillation approaches that systematically refine training datasets to universally mitigate toxic content and harmful biases in large language models.
